generalCriterionList.description: I wish to state that None of my contracts have been terminated/ foreclosed on account of my default in KPCL or elsewhere during last ten years.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
I wish to state that My offer has no conditions contravening the commercial conditions of the bid.

I wish to state that I have studied the site conditions, labor conditions and read the Bid documents and related matters carefully and diligently and that I have submitted the bid having studied understood and accepted the full implications of the tender document conditions completely.
I wish to state that I have submitted the bid having studied understood and accepted the full implications of Special Conditions/Payment methodology.

If my tender be accepted, I agree to pay 5% of the contract value plus additional security towards un-balanced tender amount towards security deposit for the due fulfillment of the contract at the time of executing agreement in the form of e-BG for the specified Guarantee period of contract.

If this tender be accepted, I agree to abide by and fulfill all the terms and provisions of the said conditions of contract annexed or in default thereof forfeit and pay to the Corporation the sum of money mentioned in the said condition without prejudice to any other right of the Corporation.

I hereby distinctly and expressly declare and acknowledge that before the submission of this tender, I have carefully read the instructions and I have made examination of contract documents and locations where such work is to be done.

I distinctly agree that I would hereafter make no claim or demand upon the Corporation based upon or arising out of any alleged misunderstanding or misconceptions or mistake on my part of the said contract, agreements, stipulations, restrictions and conditions.

If upon written information to me by the CE(FM)RTPS/ SE(CHP)M/ EE(CHP)M-2, I fail to attend the office on the date there in fixed and if upon intimation being given to me by the Superintending Engineer (CHP)M of the acceptance of the tender or fail to enter into agreement, then I agree to the forfeiture earnest money.
Any notice required to be served on me shall be sufficiently served on me by post (registered or ordinary) or left at my address given.

I fully understand the terms and agreements of the contract to be entered into between me and the Corporation and the written agreement shall be foundation of the right of both the parties and the contract shall not be deemed to be complete until an agreement has been signed by me and authorized by the proper office authorized to enter into contract by the Corporation
The rates quoted by the bidder in e-portal should be exclusive of GST.

technicalCriterionList.description: Minimum financial turnover (civil engineering construction works) not less than two times the annual payments from this contract (Rs. xxxxx Lakhs)
Satisfactoriy completed (atleast 90%) as prime contractor at-least one such similar work of value not less than Rs. xxxxxxx (80% of estimated cost of tender)
Executed in any one year the following minimum quantities of work (Cement Concrete - xxxx cum, Earthwork - xxxx cum, etc) (80% of peak rate of construction)

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid Electrical License for executing building electrificatio works and should have executed similar electrical works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid license for executing water supply / sanitary engineering works  and should have executed similar works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year
Owning the following key and critical equipment for this work (xxxx, xxxx, xxxx)
Liquid assets and /or availability of credit facilities of no less than Rs. xxxxxx Lakhs (estimated cash flow for 3 months of peak construction period)
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
List of Financial Resources with Certificates

The intending bidder should have experience as a prime contractor in Servicing of Wagon Tipplers or Primary crusher or Secondary crusher or Shuttle Conveyor or Travelling Tipper or Stacker cum Re-claimer and allied equipments of Coal Handling Plant. As a proof, bidder should upload relevant Work orders.

The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor, at least one similar work Servicing of Wagon Tipplers or Primary crusher or Secondary crusher or Shuttle Conveyor or Travelling Tipper or Stacker cum Re-claimer and allied equipments of Coal Handling Plant, of value not less than Rs. 98.86 Lakhs (Inclusive GST) in the last five years in any Thermal Power station having capacity of generating unit 200MW and above. As a proof of this, bidder should upload a single work order and corresponding work done certificates in preceding five years, issued by the competent authority (Work done of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited).

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder in his name should have achieved in at least two financial years a minimum financial turnover of Rs. 395.45 Lakhs (Inclusive GST) in the last five years, (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). As a proof of this, the bidder shall upload the certified copy of the Turnover certificate or Profit & Loss account with Balance sheet duly certified by the Chartered Accountant (Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited).
